2608.01875.title: ReasonCast: Towards Explainable Time Series Forecasting with Reasoning
2608.01875.paper_summary: Most time series (TS) models are specialized for a single task, either understanding (i.e., returning text answers about a TS) or generation (i.e., returning a numeric forecast). Only recently have unified models begun to handle the two within a single architecture. Even these models, however, produce the two outputs as task-separated paths and cannot predict a series and explain why that prediction arises within a single coherent response. In this paper, we argue for a task-fused model that jointly produces 1) prediction (generation) and 2) selfexplanation (understanding), thereby integrating 1) numerical TS forecasting and 2) interpretable text reasoning within a single response. To enable the systematic study of this capability, we present both a benchmark and a recipe that jointly address the two tasks. The benchmark, ReasonTS-Bench, identifies five fundamental patterns underlying TS and enables the joint evaluation of both tasks. ReasonCast, our recipe for finetuning any LLM to perform both tasks jointly, yields a model that generates a reasoning chain and a forecast together in a single autoregressive pass. Extensive experiments show that ReasonCast outperforms both LLMs and TS models on prediction accuracy while producing verifiable, causal reasoning. Code is available at: https://github.com/seunghan96/reasoncast.
2608.01875.paper_summary_zh: 大多數時間序列 (TS) 模型專門針對單一任務，無論是理解（即，返回有關 TS 的文本答案）或生成（即，返回數值預測）。直到最近，統一模型才開始在單一架構中處理這兩者。然而，即便這些模型，也會將這兩個輸出作為任務分離的路徑，無法在單一連貫的回應中預測一個序列並解釋該預測產生的原因。在本文中，我們主張一種任務融合模型，該模型共同產出 1) 預測（生成）和 2) 自我解釋（理解），從而在單一回應中整合 1) 數值 TS 預測和 2) 可解釋的文本推理。為了系統性地研究這一能力，我們提出了一個基準和一個配方，這兩者共同解決這兩個任務。基準 ReasonTS-Bench 確定了 TS 背後的五種基本模式，並使得這兩個任務的聯合評估成為可能。ReasonCast 是我們用於微調任何 LLM 以共同執行這兩個任務的配方，產生一個在單次自回歸過程中同時生成推理鏈和預測的模型。大量實驗顯示，ReasonCast 在預測準確性上超越了 LLM 和 TS 模型，同時產生可驗證的因果推理。代碼可在以下網址獲得：https://github.com/seunghan96/reasoncast。
